LESSON: PHONIC DEVELOPMENT

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.2: Phonic development

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Phonic development. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PHONIC DEVELOPMENT
This lesson teaches Phonic development for Grade 1 LITERACY ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Phonic development using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Phonic development above.
2. Explain Phonic development to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Phonic development.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonic development with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Phonic development important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
